data.content_ref: inline:The artifact's scope field explicitly excludes its own central claim from coverage. The 'excludes' array contains the text 'The preference for better-corroborated theories is defensible on Popper's own terms not as an inductive inference of future truth, but as a non-inductive, critical rational choice to adopt the theory,' which is a verbatim prefix of the artifact's 'claim' field. By declaring that its own thesis is outside its scope, the artifact structurally disclaims the very proposition it sets out to defend. If the scope is taken seriously, the artifact provides no coverage of the claim it makes, rendering the entire defense void by its own admission.
